title: Verify chute opening timing is tied to AGV moving in (not dropping a tote) to meet exchange KPI speed
summary: During an exchange, interpret chute opening timing using the source rule: the chute is opened when the AGV moves in (not when it drops a tote). If you see the light go off before the tote drop, treat it as potentially intentional to speed up exchanges and meet strict quick KPI targets—do not assume an immediate failure based on the light alone.
when_to_use: Use when you are observing an exchange and need to decide whether chute opening/light timing is behaving as expected for KPI-driven exchange speed (AGV move-in triggers chute open).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Observe exchange behavior and apply the chute timing rule (open on AGV move-in, not on tote drop) to interpret whether early light changes are consistent with KPI-driven operation.
access_or_tools_needed: Live system visibility of chute behavior and any associated light indication during an exchange

visual_references.description: Training video frame containing the explicit chute timing rule and KPI/light interpretation statement.

steps.title: Observe chute behavior relative to AGV motion during an exchange
steps.purpose: Establish the timing relationship between AGV move-in, chute opening, and tote drop so you can apply the correct interpretation rule.
steps.instruction: During an exchange, watch the chute and its associated light indication and note whether the chute/light changes occur when the AGV moves in versus when the tote is dropped.
steps.expected_result: You can describe whether the chute/light changes align with AGV move-in timing rather than tote-drop timing.
steps.healthy_condition: Chute/light change occurs when the AGV moves in (before the tote drop).
steps.failure_condition: Chute/light change occurs only at tote drop (i.e., not when the AGV moves in).

steps.purpose: Apply the explicit timing rule so you interpret exchange behavior correctly.
steps.instruction: Use the rule that the chute is opened when the AGV moves in (not when it drops a tote) to interpret what you observed in Step 1.

steps.title: Interpret early light changes (light on before tote drop) as potentially intentional KPI-driven behavior
steps.purpose: Prevent false failure assumptions when the light changes before the tote drop.
steps.instruction: If you see the light go off while the tote has not dropped yet, interpret it as potentially “on purpose” to speed up exchanges and meet strict quick KPI targets—do not treat it as an immediate failure solely based on the light.
steps.expected_result: You can explain the observation as consistent with KPI-driven exchange speed (light before tote drop is expected/intentional).
steps.healthy_condition: Light changes occur before tote drop, and the exchange continues without being treated as an immediate failure based only on the light.
steps.failure_condition: The exchange behavior indicates a stall or other issue despite the KPI-driven timing intent (escalate per Step 4).

actions.label: Interpret light timing
actions.exact_action: If you see the light go off and it hasn't dropped its tote, interpret it as on purpose because we're trying to speed up the exchanges.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: “We have very strict quick KPI's we have to meet... if you see the light go off and it hasn't dropped its tote, that's on purpose because we're trying to speed up the exchanges.”

steps.title: Stop and request support/clarification if chute timing contradicts the rule
steps.purpose: Ensure incorrect timing behavior is handled as a potential issue rather than misinterpreted.
steps.instruction: If the observed behavior contradicts the source rule (e.g., chute opens only at tote drop rather than at AGV move-in), stop applying the KPI/light interpretation and request support/clarification.
steps.expected_result: You have identified a contradiction to the chute timing rule and initiated escalation/clarification rather than continuing with the assumption.
steps.healthy_condition: No contradiction is present; chute/light timing aligns with AGV move-in.
steps.failure_condition: Contradiction is present (chute opens only at tote drop).
